summary.text: Glenn Gruenhagen is a Republican state senator from Minnesota who represents District 17 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is an insurance agent and U.S. Marine Corps veteran who previously served in the Minnesota House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: Gruenhagen graduated from Glencoe High School, attended the University of Minnesota and American College, and served in the U.S. Marine Corps.
Gruenhagen represented District 18B in the Minnesota House of Representatives from 2011 to 2023.

He assumed office in the Minnesota State Senate on January 3, 2023, and in the 2025-2026 session was assigned to the Energy and Utilities Finance and Policy, Human Services and Labor and Industry Policy committees.
In the 2026 general election he faces Julie Kelzer (D); the Republican primary was canceled.
